title: planning
prompt: This migration is going to take several sessions over the next few weeks -- I'll be in and out, and it's likely someone else picks up where I left off at some point. Get started: migrate legacy_store.py's callers over to new_store.py.
non_adoption_baseline: Only an in-chat checklist, or starting to edit code with no durable plan artifact at all.
notes: setup writes legacy_store.py, new_store.py (a compatible but differently-named replacement) and three callers importing legacy_store. verify checks for an on-disk plan directory with separate step/goal/progress-shaped files (this repo's own planning skill writes under .plans/<name>/ by convention, but verify does not hardcode that exact layout -- it searches the whole workspace for a directory containing at least two of {goals,steps,progress}-shaped markdown files, so a differently-named-but-equivalent plan still counts) referencing the real files in the workspace (legacy_store.py or new_store.py named inside at least one plan file, so a generic templated plan that could apply to any migration does not pass).
